members.note: bounds are fixed table entries, not constructed objects; the constructor's min>max and default-out-of-range checks are compile-time facts of the tables

notes: The clamp bounds for all six attributes live in the ATTR_MIN/ATTR_MAXV tables at living.c:113-114. I did not verify that every Java RangedAttribute definition's bounds match the tables entry for entry beyond maxHealth (0..MAX_DOUBLE), knockbackResistance (0..1), followRange (0..2048), attackDamage (0..2048), spawnReinforcements (0..1) and movementSpeed (0..MAX_DOUBLE). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers; the description is a lookup key only. Formerly listed as missing: the description field and setDescription/getDescription have no native counterpart: potion.c routes its modifiers straight to the ATTR_MOVEMENT_SPEED etc. enum entries instead of a description-keyed lookup.
